title: Ramen Noodle Stir-Fry

items: 2 packs (3 oz each) instant ramen, seasoning packets discarded, or 6 oz flat rice noodles
1 boneless skinless chicken breast (about 8 oz), sliced into thin bite-size strips
2 Tbsp neutral oil, plus 1 tsp for the noodles
1 medium carrot, peeled and cut into thin matchsticks

steps: Stir the sauce ingredients in a small bowl. Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Cook the ramen 2 min, just until the noodles separate. For rice noodles, cook 1–2 min less than the package says. Drain, rinse briefly with cold water and toss with 1 tsp oil so they don't stick.

Season the chicken with the salt. Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Cook the chicken 4–5 min, stirring now and then, until browned and it reads 165°F. Move to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 Tbsp oil, the broccoli and carrot and stir-fry 2 min. Add the bell pepper and 2 Tbsp water and stir-fry 2 min more, until the water is gone and the vegetables are crisp-tender.
Turn the heat to high. Add the noodles, chicken and sauce and toss with tongs 1–2 min, until the noodles are hot and evenly coated.
tips: Rice noodles break easily. Cook them only until just bendable, since they soften more in the pan.
Shrimp or tofu work in place of chicken. Cook shrimp 1–2 min per side, until pink and opaque.
Add chili crisp or sriracha at the table for heat.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days. Reheat in a skillet over medium heat with a splash of water, or in the microwave, until hot (165°F). The noodles soften as they sit.
